exercise.name: Wide Push-Up
exercise.description: A push-up variation with a wider hand placement to increase the emphasis on the outer chest muscles and shoulders.
instructions: Place hands wider than shoulder-width apart on the floor.
Descend until your chest nearly touches the floor, keeping your core tight.
Drive through your palms to return to the start position.
Keep a straight line from head to heels and do not let the lower back sag.
